subject: Soft serve machine cleaning cycle stuck at 45% completion
description: The soft serve machine (POS-0025-T1) initiated its automated cleaning cycle this evening but has become unresponsive midway through the process. The display shows the cycle at 45% completion and has not progressed for approximately 25 minutes. The machine is currently non-functional and unable to serve customers. We have attempted a power cycle but the issue persists. The cleaning solution appears to be circulating normally, but the cycle completion logic seems to have failed.
